summary: Unlock your potential in Treasury and Cash Management with our expert-led training. Learn to navigate complex financial landscapes and optimize cash resources.
lede: Treasury management training gives finance professionals practical methods to plan liquidity, oversee cash operations, and assess funding and risk. The course covers building cash forecasts, managing working capital and liquidity buffers, reviewing bank relationships, and monitoring foreign exchange, interest-rate, and counterparty exposure. Participants also practice creating liquidity dashboards and risk registers and assessing treasury technology, automation, and cash-forecasting data limits.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for finance professionals who manage liquidity, payments, bank relationships, funding, and treasury reporting in real operational settings. Treasury Analysts who prepare cash positions and liquidity reports. Cash Managers who oversee daily balances and payment timing. Treasury Controllers who manage controls, limits, and policy compliance. Corporate Treasurers who direct funding, investing, and risk decisions. Finance Managers who coordinate cash flow and working capital. Cash Forecast Analysts who maintain forecast models and variance reviews. Bank Relationship Managers who monitor service levels and fee structures. Accounts Receivable Managers who influence collections timing and cash inflow. Accounts Payable Managers who manage disbursement timing and supplier settlement. Risk Managers who track FX, interest rate, and counterparty exposure.
modules: Treasury Operating Model and Liquidity Mandate
Liquidity Planning and Working Capital Control
prerequisites: You need a laptop, spreadsheet software, and a working knowledge of basic finance terms such as liquidity, receivables, payables, and cash flow. If available, bring anonymized treasury reports, bank statements, or a sample cash forecast so you can complete the exercises using realistic data.
